text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain condemns Israel's plans to build new settlements in East Jerusalem as an obstacle to the Middle East peace process.
- British warship builder Vosper Thorneycroft expects multi-million-dollar orders from Gulf states after Prince Charles' visit to the region.
- Bahrain's state security court begins trial of people accused of plotting to topple Bahrain's government.
- Egyptian trade delegation to visit Bahrain on Tuesday to seek trade opportunities.
- Bahrain, Qatar agree to open embassies. Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a territorial dispute over small islands in the Gulf controlled by Bahrain but claimed by Qatar.
